notes: FoodFinder now helps when you're dining out. If it detects you're at a restaurant, it asks which spot and what you ordered, then pulls authoritative menu nutrition — saving your AI tokens. No match? It falls back to the usual AI photo analysis, or you can browse the restaurant's full menu. Also: all your PowerPack apps are now grouped together in Settings under a 'You've powered up with Loop PowerPack' banner.
